The current pre-Alpha page retained the reported sentence that no infinite-coproduct hypothesis could even be stated. This is false: for every Y the Hom from zero is a singleton, so zero with its unique injections is the countable zero-family coproduct. Preservation of existing coproducts is a meaningful condition; nonexistence of the countable regular-module coproduct establishes only noncocompleteness. Alpha replaced the sentence by the exact finite Eilenberg-Watts conclusion: no additional infinite-coproduct preservation hypothesis is required, and gave the zero-family caveat. The other page paragraphs match the reviewed examples. No item claim was altered.
